module.purpose: Implements React's experimental createEventHandle API, returning a function that attaches native event listeners to a target (EventTarget or React-managed node) and returns a cleanup callback.
module.summary: This module provides the client-side implementation of the createEventHandle factory for React DOM. It exposes a single exported function that, when enabled via feature flag, returns an event handle closure. The closure validates its target and callback, lazily registers a native event listener through the plugin event system for non-managed targets, and maintains a per-target set of listeners. It relies on internal component tree helpers and feature flags, and throws descriptive errors for invalid events or targets.
module.businessContext: Part of React DOM event system internals. Enables programmatic attachment of native event listeners. Failure breaks custom event handle API and non-managed target listening.

detail.name: isValidEventTarget
preconditions: The target argument must be a value that allows property access (i.e., not null or undefined).
postconditions: Returns true if the target object exposes a callable addEventListener method; otherwise returns false.

Falsy values such as null or undefined cause a type error when cast to Object and accessed via addEventListener.

detail.name: eventHandle
preconditions: target must be a valid EventTarget or ReactScopeInstance
callback must be a function (throws otherwise)
